title: Gustave Doré: Cain and Abel Offering Their Sacrifices (1870)
summary: Closing slide showing Gustave Doré's 1870 engraving of Cain and Abel offering their sacrifices.

text.text: Cain and Abel Offering Their Sacrifices

pictures.description: Black-and-white engraving: two brothers at their altars under a dark sky; smoke from Abel's offering rises upward while Cain's offering lies on the ground, with a tree and rocky landscape.
